chunks: "Whoever clears his throat in the mosque and then returns it into his interior, no illness will pass by except that it will cure him."

key_terms.أَبْرَأَتْهُ: it cured him or restored him to health
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, the sacred place of worship
key_terms.تَنَخَّمَ: cleared his throat or brought up phlegm

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about clearing one's throat in the mosque and swallowing it back?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describes a specific act done in the mosque and attributes a bodily benefit to it. It appears in the chapter on the virtue and sanctity of mosques, linking conduct within the mosque to spiritual and physical benefit.
